name: Simeon
summary: A just and devout man in Jerusalem who was waiting for the comfort of Israel. The Holy Ghost had shown him he would not die before seeing the Lord's Christ, and he took the baby Jesus in his arms in the temple.

key_moments.title: Takes the Child Jesus in His Arms
key_moments.description: Led by the Spirit, Simeon came into the temple when Jesus' parents brought Him there. He took the child in his arms, blessed God, and said he could now depart in peace, for he had seen God's salvation.

key_moments.title: Warns Mary of a Sword
key_moments.description: Simeon blessed Joseph and Mary and told Mary that this child would make many in Israel fall and rise again. He said a sword would pierce her own soul too.
